articles.title: Pegula Saves Match Point to Reach WTA Finals Last Four
articles.summary: Jessica Pegula saved a match point to beat Linda Noskova and reach the WTA Finals semi-finals, where she will face Mirra Andreeva.

articles.title: A Free Music Festival Will Warm Up College Football's Big Game
articles.summary: A free two-day DJ festival starring David Guetta, Marshmello, John Summit and more will warm up Las Vegas ahead of the College Football Playoff championship game on January 25.

articles.title: An AI Copilot That Helps Engineers Design Better Buildings
articles.summary: MIT researchers built an AI copilot for design that lets engineers shape a structure as the computer creates it, producing stronger, easier-to-make parts.
